# discord_text_channel (Resource)

Manages a Discord text channel.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the text channel (1-100 characters).
- `server_id` (String) The server (guild) ID where the channel will be created.

### Optional

- `category` (String) The ID of the parent category channel.
- `nsfw` (Boolean) Whether the channel is NSFW.
- `position` (Number) The position of the channel in the channel list.
- `rate_limit_per_user` (Number) Slowmode rate limit in seconds (0-21600). 0 means disabled.
- `sync_perms_with_category` (Boolean) Whether to sync permissions with the parent category.
- `topic` (String) The channel topic (0-1024 characters).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the channel.
